purpose: Connect existing N1 machine evidence to N2 without silently retaining manual feature answers or promoting local source structure into preparation completion.
registration_scope: Registered after metadata/schema inventory, before new bridge code, tests or real-pool bridge outputs. This is development on already-read cases, not an independent experiment.

method.bridge: A small pure adapter plus field-level provenance and meaningful boundary tests. No changes to the prior selector or frozen N1 components.
method.rules: Explicit, reviewed relation selectors and guard-domain normalization; no profile-ID, architecture-name, revision-label or old outcome lookup as a feature value.
method.structural_diagnostics: Recover relative call order only if all enumerated bounded local paths contain one direct preparation call and one notify call, in the same order. Recover guard candidates from existing forward structure with exact source/parameter binding. Preserve loop/frontier and unpreprocessed scope.
method.effective_features: The original qualification_domain/preparation_phase requirements stay unchanged. Export only adequately version/config/object/semantics-bound features; otherwise null and insufficient. A helper call before notify is not an effect-completion certificate.
method.profile_update: Start from a deep copy, clear all old provider.features, attach new evidence references, and invalidate the old review. Do not automatically approve a changed profile or mark it legal from hashes.
method.source_context: Unpreprocessed source facts and non-instrumented configured regions must not masquerade as runtime-profile evidence. A same revision or a subset of common config switches is insufficient for automatic context transfer.
method.identity: Verify payload and artifact identities, exact JSON selectors, source digest, revision and configuration independently; hashes only detect drift, not truth.

real_pool.outputs: New bridge outputs and selector result under this stage only. Old pool, selection and replay remain unchanged.
real_pool.expected_gap_not_a_target: Prior inventory suggests formal features will remain insufficient. Preserve the actual result, never fill gaps to reproduce P01/P03.

bounded_extra_check: May compare only the two recorded original s390 config files with the two existing runtime configs using their registered hashes; save differences and limits. No source fetch, helper expansion, new preprocessor/build or runtime.
validation: positive synthetic binding/structural projections as method tests
missing and conflicting paths or duplicate calls
wrong revision/config/source digest or stale review
clearing prior answers and no in-place mutation
existing four-profile integration and unchanged original selection
exit: Save executable bridge, tests, actual field provenance and insufficiency reasons, bounded config comparison and independent review; update the current checkpoint and the single daily log. Do not claim new defects, independent gain or complete N1/N2.
